selection.ownership: ALTOVIZ SAS, 46 bis Avenue du Maine, 75015 Paris, France (SIREN 913 819 116). The reviewed edition is the public REST API at api.altoviz.com with English developer docs, not a mainland-China product.

research.searchCoverage: Official Altoviz OpenAPI (GET /v1/customers, GET /v1/customers/{id}, GET /v1/customers/find, GET /v1/users/me, GET /hello), X-API-KEY authentication, company identity, and dated incident search for Altoviz security breach/incident reviewed on 2026-09-13. No qualifying current unresolved Altoviz customer-data compromise was identified in reviewed coverage; this is not a breach-free claim.

Official Altoviz REST v1 at https://api.altoviz.com with X-API-KEY, customer list/get/find, and GET /v1/users/me. Dated incident search on 2026-09-13 found no qualifying unresolved Altoviz compromise. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to official GET /v1/customers?PageIndex=1&PageSize=1, a cheap authenticated page, rather than the pinned validator's GET /v1/Users/me which is not a listed action.
Official OpenAPI paths are lowercase /v1/customers; pinned source uses PascalCase /v1/Customers. Native follows the OpenAPI document.
Native header is x-api-key matching the pinned source; OpenAPI documents X-API-KEY (HTTP header names are case-insensitive).
GET omits Content-Type and the upstream user-agent because no JSON body is sent.
Optional PageIndex, PageSize and OrderBy bind to documented query names. Full-text query is omitted so list is not used as a search.
Returns the raw customer array under data (OpenAPI 200 schema is an array).
Numeric customerId is URL-encoded in GET /v1/customers/{id}. Returns raw Altoviz JSON under data.
email, internalId and number bind to documented Find query names. Returns the raw matching array under data.
